how_these_were_written: How a shared link actually arrives. 'found this on HN' is kept and marked non-lexical: no word in it overlaps any honest description, and pretending otherwise would mean padding the description with noise. The near-misses are work on a repo we already use, and the other two doors.

cases.prompt: is this library worth installing or not
someone shared this, should we adopt it
evaluate this model for us before we depend on it
do we want to take on another dependency for this
clone the repo we already use and run its tests
what does done mean for this feature before we build it
decide what survives compaction and save it durably
